name: split
title: Split
description: Panes side by side that stack below a width of the layout itself: split screens, list and detail, media and text.

when: A screen of two (or more) panes that sit side by side when there is room: a sign-in form beside a brand pane, a list beside its detail.
The split must follow the space the layout gets (a dialog, a shell with a sidebar), not the window.

instead.when: Equal columns of cards or tiles that wrap.
The app's navigation beside the page.

guidance.rule: Hide a decorative pane on narrow layouts with hideOnNarrow; never hide the pane that holds the task.
Put the page's one main landmark on the pane that holds the task (`as="main"`) when the Split is the whole page.

builtIn: A pane hidden on narrow layouts is display: none, so it leaves the accessibility tree too.
Panes follow source order in every layout, so reading and tab order never jump.
youProvide: The landmark of each pane (`as="main"`, `as="aside"`) and the headings in it.
